Every rest-frame number in this paper (Eiso 2.37e49, L_peak 2.30e50, Gamma >= 430) inherits that circularity. Cite as a CLAIM, never as z.

papers.title: High energy time lags of Gamma Ray Bursts
papers.classification: sample-member with per-burst lag AND an independent LLE-only spectral index. Found by corpus token-grep.
papers.definition_note_T3: Bands are fixed and MUST be copied with the numbers: Band 1 = 10-100 keV (GBM NaI), Band 2 = 150-500 keV (BGO), Band 3 = 500 keV-1 MeV (BGO), Band 4 = 30-100 MeV (LAT-LLE). Method = discrete Cross-Correlation Function, asymmetric-Gaussian fit to the DCF peak, 1 sigma from flux-randomisation Monte Carlo. SIGN CONVENTION verbatim from the abstract: 'Positive lags between the arrival time of different photon energies ... where soft photons lag behind harder ones.' phase4_consensus_DERIVED_HERE.rule: Rossi+2026 Sect. 4.1 conservative procedure - take ALL instruments/analyses, inflate the error to cover the spread; never pick a favourite. Nothing below is published as a consensus; it is derived in this harvest.

members: Qin+2021 [4.12,4.13] s Band (GBM+LLE): 11.12 +/- 2.61 MeV, beta RAILED at -5.00
Ep_sharp_peak.consensus: Ep(sharp peak) = 10 +/- 2 MeV, error dominated by the MODEL spread (CPL / Band / Band+BB), not by any single fit
Ep_sharp_peak.mandatory_caveat: Every member either rails beta at a bound or has no beta at all (CPL). In all three this Ep is an EXTRAPOLATION above the LLE band edge, never a measurement. Quote with BOUND_CAPPED on both sides of any diff.

members: GCN 14283 [4.1,5.0] s Band (GBM only, PRELIMINARY): 2100 +/- 200 keV
Ep_main_pulse_integrated.consensus: Ep(main pulse, Band frame) = 2.6 +/- 0.3 MeV. Three independent Band analyses across GBM-only and GBM+LLE agree within errors; Zhang's CPL sits inside the band.
Ep_main_pulse_integrated.excluded_and_why: Zhong+2019 CPL Ec = 4560 +/- 309 keV over [4.05,6.20] s is NOT folded in: a CPL with no beta places its Ec far above a Band Ep on the same data, and the interval adds 1.2 s of soft tail. FRAME difference, not a discrepancy.

phase4_consensus_DERIVED_HERE.T90_is_NOT_a_tension: 16.000 +/- 2.561 s (Narayana Bhat+2016) / 16.00 s (Ajello+2019) / 16.0 +/- 2.6 s (Bissaldi+2015) are TOTAL, 50-300 keV. 0.778 s (Lu+2017), 2.93 s (Zhang+2022), 2.4 s (GCN 14283, superseded-preliminary), ~3 s (Konus), 0.3 s (Suzaku WAM), 2.15 s (Suvorov+2024) are MAIN-PULSE. The bridge is T50 = 0.704 +/- 0.091 s inside T90 = 16.000 s. Do not report a T90 tension.
phase4_consensus_DERIVED_HERE.fluence_is_NOT_a_tension: Konus 3.0e-5 (20 keV-10 MeV) and Zhang 4.12e-5 ('total') vs GBM catalog 1.13e-5 (10-1000 keV) is a BAND effect. Do not report a fluence tension.
REAL_disagreements_that_survive_frame_al: PRECURSOR CONTINUUM: thermal BB (Qin+2021 dBIC 7.1; Zhang+2022) vs non-thermal CPL (Zhong+2019 dBIC -4). Weak evidence on both sides, three different intervals, kT = 45.4 / 45.06 / 71 keV. UNRESOLVED IN PRINT.

EVOLUTION CLASS: hard-to-soft (Qin+2021; Konus GCN 14285 'bright hard FRED-like structure') vs INTENSITY TRACKING (Zhang+2022 Methods, verbatim). Same data, different testable classes. UNRESOLVED IN PRINT.

BURST CLASS: LONG (Ajello+2019 2FLGC CLASS=(L); Greiner+2024 log 'L'; GBM T90 = 16 s) vs SHORT (Lu+2017 sGRB catalog; Zhong+2019 SGRB sample; Deng+2024 'fall within the classification of short bursts') vs 'Type I' (Li+2025). UNRESOLVED IN PRINT.
